rv.q: This hyperbolic take on Shakespeare’s shallowest, most good-natured comedy is an accessible and uncomplicated pleasure.
The comedy is highly accomplished, with the knockabout routines meticulously drilled and executed under the auspices of movement director Ingrid Mackinnon.
But those of us who search for more may find ourselves disappointed by a touch of flatness to it all.

cn.t: Critics praise this frenetic, fun production for its madcap energy and unapologetic silliness. Director Blanche McIntyre's hyperbolic take on Shakespeare's comedy delivers an accessible, uncomplicated pleasure with committed performances.
